newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Jubilee says to raise A$1.29 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Jubilee says to raise A$1.29 million.

text.p: Jubilee Gold Mines NL said on Monday it had agreed to place 8.75 million ordinary fully paid shares at 15.5 cents each to raise A$1.29 million in exploration funding.
The placement to clients of broker ABS White and Co will lift net cash reserves to A$1.8 million, the Western Australia miner said.

Rotary air blast drilling is underway at the North East Stockwork (Kathleen Valley) prospect near Leinster and reverse circulation drilling at the Big Mill Well workings commencing in February, the company said.
Jubilee also said it will commence an extensive air core drilling programme on its nickel targets at Kathleen Valley East and McFarlanes Find in early February, followed by deeper drilling.
Initial results should be available at the close of the March quarter, Jubilee said.
